description: JStock is open showing the Stock Watchlist with AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, and NVDA. Your task is to set a price alert for Microsoft (MSFT): you want to be notified if MSFT falls below $350.00. To set the alert: click on the MSFT row to select it, then click on the 'Fall Below' cell in the MSFT row, press F2 to enter edit mode (the cell will highlight with a blue background), type 350, and press Tab to confirm. The 'Fall Below' and 'Rise Above' columns in the watchlist table represent price alert thresholds. After setting the alert, the MSFT row should show 350.00 in the 'Fall Below' column.
